messages:
Lena (AtlasHealth): Quick sync — we're prepping a POC with Redwood but security/legal have blockers we need cleared before spinning up infra:
- SCIM: initial bulk import (~1M users) + ongoing delta sync; must support signed/encrypted payloads
- SAML: signed + encrypted assertions; custom attribute mapping (tenant_id, role)
- RBAC: delegated admin separation, tenant-level role scoping
- Audit: 7-year immutable audit logs export
- Network: private peering/VPC for POC
POC ask: Dedicated reserved for 2 weeks. Also need enterprise POC pricing + onboarding fee estimate. Can you confirm feasibility & timeline? Thanks — Lena

Maya (Sales): Thanks Lena — looping in Arjun (SE), Priya (Security), Tom (Legal). We'll confirm. Quick Q: which IdP(s)? Okta/Azure/OneLogin?

Lena (AtlasHealth): Okta + Azure AD hybrid. SCIM will be primarily from Okta. One-time bulk import then delta sync.

Arjun (SE): We can do Dedicated POC with private peering. For SCIM bulk: we support chunked imports + delta; rate limits configurable on Dedicated. For signed/encrypted SCIM we support mTLS or HMAC header. Example mTLS call:
```
curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.example/v2/Bulk \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --cert /path/to/client.crt --key /path/to/client.key \
  -d @bulk.json
```
For HMAC signed requests we support X-SCIM-Signature (HMAC-SHA256). JIT provisioning can be disabled per-tenant in the POC config.

Priya (Security): Requirements from Security: SOC2 report, encryption in transit + at rest, KMS/HSM integration options (customer-managed preferred), SCIM payload retention & redaction controls, verification docs for signed SCIM headers, and date of last pentest. For 7yr audit retention: we can export logs to customer S3 from Dedicated/Private — need contract appendix + storage cost estimate.

Tom (Legal): We can draft a retention appendix for audit logs. Need to confirm key management responsibility if customer wants KMS-managed keys.

Maya (Sales): On pricing: standard POC is usage-based + small onboarding fee. Dedicated 2-week reserved capacity can be offered with a short-term discount subject to sign-up terms. I'll get ballpark numbers and share options.

Lena (AtlasHealth): Also can you confirm SAML attribute mapping for tenant_id and role, and whether you support encrypted assertions? We must send metadata to our IdP team.

Arjun (SE): Yes — we accept signed assertions and support encrypted assertions. Attribute mapping is possible; you can map Okta attributes/groups to Redwood RBAC roles. Sample SAML attribute snippet:
```
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="tenant_id">
    <saml:AttributeValue>example-tenant-123</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="role">
    <saml:AttributeValue>admin</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```
I'll attach a metadata template in the POC ticket.

deploy-bot: POC ticket created — POC-8201. Assignees: Arjun, Maya. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/POC-8201 :rocket:

Priya (Security): Action items: upload SOC2 + pentest date, docs for X-SCIM-Signature verification, encryption-at-rest + KMS options. Also need sample DPA clauses — Tom?

Tom (Legal): I'll draft DPA and the 7-year retention appendix and circulate for review.

Maya (Sales): Next steps: I'll post pricing options + timeline by EOD tomorrow. Arjun will post POC config template in the ticket. Lena — can you send Okta org id + representative SCIM bulk file? :thumbsup:

Lena (AtlasHealth): Will send Okta org id and a sample bulk JSON tomorrow morning. Appreciate the quick turnaround. — Lena
